blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Modern British offices are very diverse, especially in big cities. One London team can have people from India, Poland, Brazil, Nigeria, Italy and every part of the UK. Each person has a different way of talking and working.

Inclusion is taken seriously. Everyone is expected to be heard, and no one is expected to be perfect. Respect differences, ask when you are not sure, and assume good intentions.

The best teams grow stronger because of this mix, not in spite of it.

items.q: Why are modern British offices very diverse?
options: Because people come from many countries
items.why: "One London team can have people from India, Poland, Brazil, Nigeria, Italy…" — muitos países.

items.q: According to the text, is anyone expected to be perfect?
options: No, no one is expected to be perfect
items.why: "no one is expected to be perfect."

items.q: What should you do when you are not sure?
items.why: "ask when you are not sure."

items.q: The text says teams grow stronger "because of this mix, not in spite of it." This suggests the author would DISAGREE with…
options: Different cultures are a problem for the team
It is good to respect differences
items.why: Inferência: o autor vê a mistura como força, não como problema.

items.q: "Assume good intentions" suggests that you should…
options: Think a colleague wants to help, even if it sounds strange
Only talk to people from your country
items.why: Inferência: assumir boas intenções = pensar que o outro quer o bem, mesmo com um estilo diferente.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie recebendo um novo colega no time. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, welcome to the team! I am Sophie. I am so happy you are here. Let me tell you a little about us before your first meeting.

We are twelve people, and we have eight nationalities. We have colleagues from India, Poland, Brazil, Italy and more. It is a beautiful mix. Everyone talks in a different way, and that is fine.

Here, everyone is heard. In meetings, we want your voice too. Please do not stay quiet. Anyone can ask a question. There is no silly question here, so please ask me anything.

And no one is perfect. We all make small mistakes with words, and that is okay. Just be kind, respect each other, and assume good intentions.

If you do not understand something, just ask. We will help you. The mix of people is our strength, not a problem. I think you will love it here. Let's start!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How many people are in the team, and how many nationalities?
items.why: "We are twelve people, and we have eight nationalities."

items.q: What does Sophie want the new colleague to do in meetings?
items.why: "we want your voice too. Please do not stay quiet."

items.q: What does Sophie say about asking questions?
options: Only the manager can ask questions
items.why: "Anyone can ask a question. There is no silly question here."

items.q: Sophie says "no one is perfect." She most likely means…
options: It is okay to make small mistakes with words
items.why: Inferência: ela tranquiliza o novo colega — pequenos erros são normais.

items.q: How would you describe Sophie's tone?
items.why: Inferência: ela diz "welcome", "so happy", "you will love it here" — tom acolhedor.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Our team is very diverse." Diverse means…
items.why: Diverse = diverso, com muitas pessoas diferentes.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "___ is welcome here. Every person matters."
items.why: Everyone = todos; combina com "every person matters".

items.q: "Inclusion is important in our office." Inclusion means…
options: making everyone feel part of the team
items.why: Inclusion = inclusão, fazer todos se sentirem parte do time.

items.q: Choose the correct phrase: "When people talk in a strange way, assume ___."
items.why: Good intentions = boas intenções; a lição pede assumir o bem.

items.q: "It is easy to live with different styles." To live with means…
options: to accept and be okay with
items.why: To live with = conviver com, aceitar e ficar de bem com.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em times multiculturais. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please speak up in the meeting." To speak up means to…
items.why: Speak up = falar, dizer sua opinião com clareza.

items.q: "We all need to get along in this team." To get along means to…
items.why: Get along = se dar bem, ter boa relação.

items.q: "Don't worry, everyone will help out." To help out means to…
items.why: Help out = dar uma ajuda, ajudar.

items.q: "Please reach out if you have a question." To reach out means to…
items.why: Reach out = entrar em contato, procurar alguém para ajuda.

items.q: "It is easy to fit in here." To fit in means to…
items.why: Fit in = se encaixar, sentir-se parte do grupo.
